newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates see-saw to end up.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates see-saw to end up.

text.p: Pakistan's money market rates fluctuated widely before ending up on Monday amid a shortage of funds and dealers said rates might continue to hover around higher levels on Tuesday.

"The market was confused over the status of liquidity available as there were some huge outflows in oil import payments and inflows in form of repayments to the central bank," a dealer at KASB & Co said.
Early deals in overnight funds were seen at 1.5 to 2.0 percent but offers rose suddenly to 14 percent, the dealer said.
